regime_context: Detector shows AI Infrastructure as the clear momentum/durability leader (rank 1, eligible, not crowded) with US Energy Complex as challenger; breadth of eligible leadership is narrowing (0.45). The one validated edge is the absolute-trend gate (drawdown/shake-out control), which is helping on this market (gate_helps=true), so the lean is toward disciplined trend-following with low directional certainty.
emerging_watch: US Energy Complex is the challenger closing on AI Infrastructure (margin 0.185) with superior breadth (0.636 vs 0.125). Watching whether energy's score overtakes AI Infrastructure's score while remaining eligible and uncrowded; if the AI Infra breadth collapses below 0.1 while energy breadth holds above 0.6, that would mark a confirmed leadership handoff worth re-ranking.

theses.subject: AI Infrastructure
theses.thesis: AI Infrastructure is the top-ranked eligible theme with the highest score (1.56) and is the confirmed rotation leader; it is not crowded (z 0.15) and remains above its durability bar (0.5). Given the absolute-trend gate is the one validated risk-control leg and this theme is trend-eligible, the lean is to retain direction while keeping a trend-gate exit discipline.
evidence: durability_bar 0.5, hurst mixed but passing gate
theses.dissent: Breadth is extremely thin (0.125), suggesting leadership is concentrated in a handful of names rather than a broad, durable rotation; hurst_tag is 'mixed' not pure trend, and the rank-IC of momentum is ~0 so the top rank carries no forward return edge.

falsifier.text: SMH closes below its 50-day moving average on two consecutive weekly closes before the check-by date

theses.thesis: US Energy Complex is the rank-2 eligible theme, the rotation challenger, with the strongest breadth of the top names (0.636) and a high durability bar (0.62) still passing. It is not crowded (z 0.93). The trend gate is helping on this market, and energy is the best-supported non-AI leadership candidate.
evidence: rotation challenger with margin 0.185 to leader
theses.dissent: Crowding_z is elevated near 1.0, which flags attention/size caution; the challenger label is display-only and rotation timing has no validated forward edge, so this could merely be a coincident energy move that stalls.

falsifier.text: XLE underperforms SPY by 5% over any rolling 20-day window before the check-by date

theses.subject: Cybersecurity
theses.thesis: Cybersecurity ranks high (3) with trend hurst and decent breadth (0.6), but it is flagged crowded (z 1.61). Per guardrails, crowding is a size-down caution and not a fade; the lean is to avoid adding rather than underweight, as the crowding flag counsels caution in a trend-gate framework.
theses.dissent: The trend is intact and breadth is solid; avoiding could mean missing continuation in a durable leadership theme, since crowding has no basket-level forward edge and is only a texture caution.
